decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental consumable line with its own web page and good fit to the firm's laboratory workflow business, it still has option value and likely low enough carrying cost to justify staying on the market.
This thermoforming blank is close to the firm's core materials offering and, despite some commodity risk, the uncertainty around market uptake is still early enough to favor keeping it.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured and is a more peripheral material, it faces a higher pruning risk, but the firm would still likely keep it one more year while uncertainty remains unresolved.
The contrast spray appears strategically aligned with digital and clinical workflows and was given its own page, so its option value likely exceeds its short-run carrying cost.
Custom earmolds fit the firm's hearing-care capabilities well, and even with only limited web prominence the product line is close enough to core competences to merit continued market presence.

Hearing protection earmolds leverage the same custom manufacturing base but are somewhat more adjacent and less prominently presented, so they are more vulnerable yet still likely worth keeping for now.
